About me

I am a PMP® and PMI-PMOCP™ certified professional with more than 19 years of experience in major offshore oil and gas construction projects, including over nine years in supervisory and managerial roles.

My experience spans the UAE, Saudi Arabia, and Egypt, covering offshore platforms, deck modules, jackets, subsea pipelines, composite cable laying, subsea structures, and marine operations. My core expertise includes project execution, constructability, resource planning, stakeholder coordination, and multidisciplinary delivery.

Alongside my construction and project management responsibilities, I develop and contribute to AI-powered and digitally enabled systems supporting vessel allocation, marine spread planning, scheduling, construction readiness, progress monitoring, and management decision-making.

Through Offshore AI Solutions, I bring practical offshore knowledge into digital development. Each solution starts with an understanding of the challenges project teams face, with the aim of improving planning, resource utilization, and execution efficiency.
